description: The file 'entry.server.tsx' is a server-side entry point for a Remix application. It handles incoming HTTP requests, determines if they are from bots or browsers, and streams server-rendered React components as HTML responses. It also manages CORS headers and request method handling.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main request handler that sets CORS headers, checks for OPTIONS method, determines if request is from a bot or browser, and delegates to appropriate handler.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering and streaming of the React app for bot requests.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering and streaming of the React app for browser requests.
